compute.oth1: [group('contrib1.c')[i] for i in range(group_size) if i != my_index]

compute.oth2: [group('contrib2.c')[i] for i in range(group_size) if i != my_index]

compute.given2: sum([group('punish.a'), group('punish.b'), group('punish.c')][t][my_index] for t in range(group_size - 1))
compute.recv2: sum([group('punish.a'), group('punish.b'), group('punish.c')][(my_index if my_index < j else my_index - 1)][j] for j in range(group_size) if j != my_index)
compute.pay2: (max(0, 20 - group('contrib2.c')[my_index] + 1.6 * sum(group('contrib2.c')) / group_size - 3 * sum([group('punish.a'), group('punish.b'), group('punish.c')][(my_index if my_index < j else my_index - 1)][j] for j in range(group_size) if j != my_index)) - sum([group('punish.a'), group('punish.b'), group('punish.c')][t][my_index] for t in range(group_size - 1)))
compute.earn2: earn2 + (max(0, 20 - group('contrib2.c')[my_index] + 1.6 * sum(group('contrib2.c')) / group_size - 3 * sum([group('punish.a'), group('punish.b'), group('punish.c')][(my_index if my_index < j else my_index - 1)][j] for j in range(group_size) if j != my_index)) - sum([group('punish.a'), group('punish.b'), group('punish.c')][t][my_index] for t in range(group_size - 1)))

fields.g_c1: mean([x for k in range(10) for x in group('contrib1.c', r=k)])
fields.g_c2: mean([x for k in range(10) for x in group('contrib2.c', s=k)])
fields.g_pun_n: sum(1 for k in range(10) for xs in [group('punish.a', s=k), group('punish.b', s=k), group('punish.c', s=k)] for x in xs if x > 0)
fields.g_sev: (sum(x for k in range(10) for xs in [group('punish.a', s=k), group('punish.b', s=k), group('punish.c', s=k)] for x in xs if x > 0) / g_pun_n) if g_pun_n else None
fields.g_eff: sum((max(0, 20 - group('contrib2.c', s=k)[I] + 1.6 * sum(group('contrib2.c', s=k)) / group_size - 3 * sum([group('punish.a', s=k), group('punish.b', s=k), group('punish.c', s=k)][(I if I < j else I - 1)][j] for j in range(group_size) if j != I)) - sum([group('punish.a', s=k), group('punish.b', s=k), group('punish.c', s=k)][t][I] for t in range(group_size - 1))) for k in range(10) for I in range(group_size)) / (group_size * 10)

unsupported.what: Tobit / multilevel regressions (Tables 2, 3, 6, 7) and logit/Tobit punishment models (Tables 4, 8)
unsupported.why: model estimates on period-level data with clustered SEs; need cited analysis code under sandbox_run (MOESM2 'Experimental data and analysis files' holds the code together with participant data; not fetched)

unsupported.what: Attrition: 84 dropouts (18%), 53% of groups complete (p. 13, Fig. 1), hazard models (Table 5)
unsupported.why: the engine has no clock, timeouts or dropouts (engine requests 1-2); the sandbox replays only complete groups, which is the paper's analysed sample (p. 12, p. 14)

unsupported.what: Comprehension pass rate: 83.2% of online participants who reached the quiz solved it (p. 10)
unsupported.why: people who never solve never finish, so they are not in the records; the share depends on the operator's retry cap, which the paper did not have (incorrect attempts: units.members.quiz1_errors)

unsupported.what: Fig. 4 (punishment by contribution difference) and Online Appendix B comparisons with Herrmann et al. 2008
unsupported.why: no numbers printed (bars only); App. B compares with other samples

unsupported.what: Age effect on first-period contributions (p. 14) and demographic controls
unsupported.why: the final questionnaire is not public (omitted); demographics are the operator's population

keyed.why: quiz keys; contributions online > lab in every period (period 1 15 vs 11, decaying to 8.5/4.5 by period 10); periods 11-20 higher than 1-10 and online above lab (18 vs 16); lab punishes more often (p = .17 vs .07) with 1-6 points, so online efficiency is higher; nobody excluded
